detail.longDescription: ⛓️‍💥There it is again: AI Jailbreaking Russian threat actor "Trim" developed methods to circumvent the guard rails put in place by Fable 5. What I find most interesting about this incident is that as soon as the system prompt is leaked, the attacker finds ways to circumvent it. I think the main problem is that the undesired capabilities of a model are not removed but rather barred by using system prompts. As we all know, defences can be breached. Therefore, as long as these features are part of the LLM, there is always a way to get to them and use them. Then the question becomes. Can LLM models be built in a way that the system is not able to act on a prompt, even if it wants to?
